name: findling
description: Search your local files by meaning and by exact words, with passages ready to cite.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Findling, a private search over folders on this Mac (documents, PDFs, web pages, notes, code). Results come grouped per file with their best passages, heading paths, pages and a link that shows each passage highlighted in your browser. Claude can also read on from a passage, open a section by name ("§ 1599"), and browse folders, files and sections.

The Findling web app must be running (in the Findling folder: `uv run findling`). This extension only forwards to it: the search model and the index stay in the app.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Hybrid search (by meaning and exact words) over the indexed folders, a folder or a file; results grouped per file with passages.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Reads an indexed file around a passage or a section (e.g. "§ 1599"), with links to cite each section.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Lists the indexed folders, the files in a folder, or the sections of a file.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Opens a file in the browser with the passage highlighted (Office files in their app).

findling_dir.title: Findling folder
findling_dir.description: The Findling project folder (the one with pyproject.toml).

port.title: Port
port.description: Port of the Findling web app (FINDLING_PORT).

uv_path.title: uv program (optional)
uv_path.description: Only needed if uv isn't in a usual place (~/.local/bin, Homebrew, /usr/local/bin, ~/.cargo/bin).
